# AEGIS — Autonomous Program Vulnerability Repair & Formal Invariant Verification

> Autonomous Engine for Program Vulnerability Repair and Formal Invariant Verification in CI/CD Pipelines.

## Core Capabilities
- Polyglot AST Taint Localization: 2-pass AST propagation with line/col precision.
- Microsoft Z3 SMT Formal Theorem Verification: First-Order Logic invariant proofs (QF_S).
- Autonomous Patch Synthesis: Sound syntactic transformations (parameterization, sanitization, allowlisting).
- Sandboxed Regression Chamber: Regression testing with microsecond latency reporting.
- Relational SQLite Relational Store: Persistent audit logs, proofs, patches, and scans in WAL mode.

## API Documentation
- GET /api/health: Returns kernel uptime, SQLite table stats, and Z3 solver engine status.
- GET /api/vulnerabilities: Returns normalized bundles containing vulnerability, patch diffs, formal proofs, and tests.
- POST /api/verify/z3: Executes Microsoft Z3 theorem proof against patch candidate.
- POST /api/db/query: Safe query explorer allowing read-only SELECT and PRAGMA queries.
- POST /api/pr/merge: Atomically executes pull request merge and commits audit trail to SQLite.
